標題： 🎓 畢典住宿快訊！東華美崙斯中樓開放預訂住宿啦！ 🏠✨
日期： Tue, 29 Apr 2025 08:50:21 +0800

親愛的畢業生們：
畢業典禮即將來臨，東華美崙校區斯中樓現已開放住宿預訂！目前還有20間舒適套房，供家長入住，讓他們輕鬆參加畢業典禮。
💬 住宿資訊一覽：
🏢 地點：美崙校區斯中樓
🛏 房型：每間套房有兩大床，舒適又寬敞！
💸 價格：每晚NT$1,500元（超實惠！）
🛎 數量：目前剩下20間，先搶先得！
📞 聯絡人：丁助理 03-8906952
🔗 訂宿系統：
請使用以下鏈接進行預訂：
https://reurl.cc/K887Rm
學生可以使用學生電子郵件註冊帳號。
若家長需要，也可以使用校外帳號進行申請。
⏳ 房間數量有限，請儘快預訂！
✅ 讓您的家長在畢業典禮期間享有舒適的住宿，一起慶祝這個難忘的時刻！
快來預訂吧，讓我們一起迎接畢業的榮耀！🎉🎓
🎓 Graduation Ceremony Accommodation Last-minute Promotion! Dong Hwa Meilun Shih Chung Building Now Open for Reservations! 🏠✨
Dear Graduates,
Still looking for accommodation for your family during your graduation ceremony? The Shih Chung Building at the Meilun Campus now has 20 cozy suites available for your family and friends.
💬 Accommodation Details:
🏢 Location: Shih Chung Building, Meilun Campus 
 (https://maps.app.goo.gl/wjBA7aVuboTdbZXX8)
🛏 Room Type: Each suite features two large beds—comfortable and spacious!
💸 Price: NT$1,500 per night (Super affordable!)
🛎 Availability: Only 20 rooms available—first come, first served!
📞 Contact: Assistant Ding at +886-3-8906952
🔗 Reservation System:
Reserve your room via the link below:
https://reurl.cc/K887Rm
Students can register using their student email.
Parents may also apply using an external account if needed.
⏳ Rooms are limited— book as soon as possible!
✅ Let your parents enjoy a comfortable stay while celebrating this unforgettable milestone with you!
Book now and get ready to celebrate your graduation together! 🎉🎓
